solutions.name: Enterprise Systems & ERP
solutions.alt: Business leader running operations on one ERP platform
solutions.summary: Finance, procurement, inventory, HR, sales, operations and reporting brought together in one enterprise environment.
solutions.headline: Bring core operations onto one connected platform.
solutions.lede: Hamerkop implements, customizes, supports and recovers ERP environments that connect finance, procurement, human resources, inventory, sales, operations and reporting. The engagement begins with the operating model rather than the software screen: how work moves between teams, where approvals happen, which records are trusted, how management reports are prepared and which systems already exist around the ERP.
solutions.scope: ERP work can include Odoo and Hamerkop ERP offerings, Ethiopian localization, process design, system configuration, custom modules, data migration, integration, testing, user training, go-live and post-launch support.
designed_for: Organizations implementing ERP for the first time
Organizations replacing an aging or fragmented ERP environment
Businesses moving beyond spreadsheets and disconnected departmental tools
Institutions expanding an existing ERP or recovering a stalled implementation
capabilities: Financial records and operational activity are managed in the same controlled environment.
Purchasing, stock movement and operational demand remain connected across the operating cycle.
HR, roles, approvals and cross-department processes are handled within the shared enterprise environment.
Sales activity stays connected with inventory, invoicing and finance.
Management reporting is built on information captured through day-to-day operations.
Move from legacy environments or restore direction to stalled ERP programs.

solutions.name: Electronic Invoicing
solutions.summary: Electronic invoice and receipt workflows connected with ERP, finance, billing and point-of-sale systems.
solutions.headline: Make invoicing part of a controlled, auditable digital process.
solutions.lede: Electronic invoicing is not an isolated document-generation process. It sits between sales, finance, billing, tax reporting, customer records and the systems where the underlying transaction is created. Hamerkop approaches electronic invoicing as an integrated operational workflow so the invoicing layer works with the wider institution.
solutions.scope: Electronic invoicing work covers Hamerkop EIMS, invoice and receipt workflows, validation, reporting, audit records and integration with ERP, finance, billing and point-of-sale environments.
designed_for: Organizations preparing for electronic invoicing requirements
Institutions that need invoicing connected to ERP, finance, billing or POS
Organizations managing complex invoice volumes or multiple operating locations
Teams that require clearer traceability around invoice status and reporting
capabilities: Structured creation, validation, status handling and record keeping.
Invoicing is connected with ERP, finance, billing and POS environments.
Operational and regulatory reporting draws from structured transaction data.
Important invoice events and workflow activity remain traceable through a clear transaction record.
User roles separate the creation, management and review of invoice activity.
EIMS is introduced around the organization’s existing invoicing process and the operational systems that feed it.

solutions.name: Financial Technology
solutions.summary: Payments, collections, reconciliation, settlement, merchant operations and financial-system integration.
solutions.headline: Build financial workflows that connect transactions to operations.
solutions.lede: Financial technology creates value when a transaction can move cleanly from initiation to record, reconciliation, settlement and reporting. Hamerkop develops and integrates the systems around these workflows for financial institutions, merchants and organizations with complex transaction environments.
solutions.scope: Financial technology work covers payments, merchant operating systems, digital onboarding, KYC processes, collections, reconciliation, settlement and integration with core banking, MFI and enterprise platforms.
designed_for: Banks and microfinance institutions
Insurance and merchant environments
Organizations managing collections, settlement or reconciliation workflows
Institutions connecting payment activity to core systems
capabilities: Payment collection activity remains linked to the operational records behind each transaction.
Reconciliation brings transaction records together for comparison, investigation and resolution.
Transaction capture, processing and settlement follow a controlled financial workflow.
Technology around merchants, payment activity and related operational workflows.
Financial workflows integrate with core banking, MFI and enterprise systems.

solutions.name: Identity & Trust
solutions.summary: Authentication, verification, role management and controlled access across institutional applications.
solutions.headline: Know who is accessing the system — and what they are allowed to do.
solutions.lede: Digital operations depend on trusted identities. Hamerkop designs identity and access environments around authentication, verification, role management and controlled access so users can be connected to the right functions and data across institutional systems.
solutions.scope: Identity work covers digital identity, authentication, access control, verification workflows and role management across standalone applications or wider ERP, financial, government and enterprise environments.
designed_for: Institutions managing multiple applications and user roles
Financial and public-sector environments with controlled access requirements
Platforms that need verification and secure institutional onboarding
Enterprise systems requiring role-based permissions
capabilities: Authentication establishes how users prove identity before entering a system.
Verification workflows confirm identity and institutional access requirements.
Users are linked to defined roles and permissions.
Limit functions and information according to institutional responsibility.
Identity controls integrate with ERP, financial and other institutional platforms.
Secure access extends across internal and external user environments.

solutions.name: Enterprise Integration
solutions.summary: Connect critical applications and data flows so enterprise systems can operate as one environment.
solutions.headline: Make different systems work as one operating environment.
solutions.lede: Institutional technology rarely lives in one system. ERP, banking applications, payment platforms, government systems, billing tools and legacy applications often need to exchange information continuously. Hamerkop designs integration environments that connect those systems through defined, monitored interfaces.
solutions.scope: Integration work covers API management, integration platforms, government interoperability, legacy modernization, monitoring, observability and service-level management around connected systems.
designed_for: Organizations running multiple critical platforms
Institutions modernizing legacy systems without replacing everything at once
Government environments requiring interoperability
Businesses connecting ERP, banking, payment, billing and operational applications
capabilities: Controlled interfaces govern how systems and data services communicate.
Applications across different vendors and technology environments operate through managed integrations.
Extend the value of existing systems while new platforms are introduced.
Institutional systems exchange information through defined structures and interfaces.
Monitoring provides visibility into integration health and service behavior.
Runbooks and service-level documentation support long-term operation and ownership.

solutions.name: Data, Analytics & AI
solutions.summary: Data warehousing, business intelligence, dashboards, document intelligence and data governance.
solutions.headline: Turn institutional data into information people can act on.
solutions.lede: Institutions often have large amounts of information but limited ability to use it consistently. Hamerkop helps structure and consolidate data across systems so reporting and analysis are based on clearer, more controlled information.
solutions.scope: Data work covers data warehousing, business intelligence, executive reporting, predictive analytics, document intelligence and data governance across institutional information environments.
designed_for: Organizations with reporting spread across multiple systems
Leadership teams that need more reliable operational and financial visibility
Institutions building a structured data environment
Teams exploring practical analytics and AI use cases
capabilities: Information from operational systems is consolidated into a structured reporting environment.
Dashboards and reporting reflect the information required for institutional decisions.
Present management information in a clearer and more consistent form.
Apply analytical models where historical data supports forward-looking insight.
Document intelligence extracts and organizes information held in institutional documents.
Data governance clarifies ownership, access and appropriate use of institutional information.
